description: Use when the user asks whether a domain has DKIM but no selector is known. Tries 31 common selectors and returns each key found with type, size and flags. None found is a hint, not proof that DKIM is missing. Ex: 'Does example.com use DKIM?'. Free trial without an API key: a few calls a day.

domain.description: A public domain name, e.g. example.com.
